title: The Geometry of Conceptors in Neural-Activation Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2611.19075v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conceptors represent concepts as graded collections of directions in neural-activation space rather than as single vectors. We develop a geometric account of how these representations depend on the contrast used to define a concept: opposing values in bipolar fitting, or presence and absence in unipolar fitting. We derive an exact decomposition of a centered pooled conceptor into an average pole filter, a mean-separation update, and a covariance-shape update. Experiments across five language models on sentiment, political leaning and stance, and depression expression show that both updates improve reconstruction of held-out contrasts. Additional directions preserve variation beyond the mean-difference line, and changing the comparator changes the benefit of these directions. Shape, size, and overlap each show up downstream: in amplification experiments, bipolar fits raise evidence for both poles more consistently than unipolar fits; conc

translated_title: 神经激活空间中概念子的几何学
translated_abstract: 概念子将概念表示为神经激活空间中分级的方向集合，而不是单一向量。我们建立了一个几何学解释，说明这些表示如何依赖于用于定义概念的对比方式：双极拟合中的对立取值，或单极拟合中的存在与缺失。我们推导出中心化池化概念子的精确分解，将其分解为一个平均极滤波器、一个均值分离更新和一个协方差形状更新。在五个语言模型上针对情感、政治倾向与立场以及抑郁表达的实验表明，这两种更新都能改善对保留对比的重构。额外方向保留了超出均值差线的变异，而改变比较器会改变这些方向带来的收益。形状、大小和重叠各自体现在下游任务中：在放大实验中，双极拟合比单极拟合更一致地提升两极的证据……
tldr: 本文提出了概念子在神经激活空间中的几何理论，将中心化池化概念子精确分解为平均极滤波器、均值分离更新和协方差形状更新，并通过五个语言模型上的实验证明双极与单极对比拟合方式会显著影响概念表示的重构效果与下游行为。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a geometric account of conceptors in neural-activation spaces, deriving an exact decomposition into an average pole filter, a mean-separation update, and a covariance-shape update, and demonstrating across five language models how bipolar versus unipolar contrast fitting shapes reconstruction quality and downstream behavior.
